title: Department penalty for failing to complete facade repairs in a timely manner.
officialText:
In addition to any other penalties that may be imposed under any other provision of law, the owner of a building subject to the requirements of article 302 of chapter 3 of this title may be subject to a penalty where facade repairs are not commenced and completed as required by this section.

(L.L. 2025/051, 4/17/2025, eff. 1/12/2026)
